x: Harry Blackstaffe won over a hundred awards for rowing. He was a determined and persistent individual, which was evident in his attempt to win the Diamond Sculls at Henley (this event is a knockout individual contest, open to top international scullers from all over the world).

The minutes were signed by H T Blackstaffe, our President in 1909, who had won a gold medal for the single sculls in 1908! The next AGM, 1909, might well be written last year - races not supported, subscriptions unpaid and also, perhaps surprisingly, 85 new members were approved by the committee in the year.
